gen-dafont-disorder-gf-anek-odia: Disorder sprawls raw and loose, every stroke drawn at a single width. Anek Odia is contemporary and tidy, its rounds left unlatched like open hooks and its stroke contrast low, so the chaos has a steady partner.
gen-dafont-disorder-gf-anek-tamil: Raw, scrappy lettering: Disorder spaces its tall lowercase far apart, and its n arches match the stems in weight. Anek Tamil brings big round bowls and half-unwrapped curves to soften it.
gen-dafont-disorder-gf-anek-telugu: Anek Telugu reads friendly, its wide, tall bowls setting the rhythm. Above it, Disorder scatters raw, big-lowercase letters without any stroke variation, a shout the body then talks down.
gen-dafont-disorder-gf-anuphan: Chaotic by nature, Disorder is best at drawing attention with a wire-like monoline skeleton. Anuphan handles the quieter job, its big round bowls and open curves leaving clear gaps for the text.
gen-dafont-disorder-gf-armata: Disorder looks like a sign-painter's single-stroke brush gone rowdy, every line at constant width and every glyph set far apart. Armata's spacious gaps between characters give that brushwork room to breathe.
gen-dafont-disorder-gf-athiti: Raw and rattling, Disorder spaces its big lowercase far apart, while Athiti keeps a gap you can see through in each s. One shouts, the other tidies up behind it.
gen-dafont-disorder-gf-atkinson-hyperleg: Loud and scattered, Disorder draws plain constant-width lines with oversized lowercase. Atkinson Hyperlegible is better at restraint, its s terminals set wide and its capitals clipped beside the lowercase.

Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono spaces its letters like stencil bridges stretched far open. Disorder is best at scrawling, each stroke seemingly drawn with a fixed pen, while the body font lets its counters breathe.

Disorder's lowercase towers, huge and far apart, all in one gentle monotone of line thickness. Atkinson Hyperlegible Next is better at the quiet part, with washer-big lowercase eyes and rounds left unlatched like open hooks.
gen-dafont-disorder-gf-biryani: Biryani reads friendly and open, with a large clear eye on every e and no stroke contrast at all. And because its counters never clog, it can drop to a modest size while Disorder keeps shouting.
